systems.country_label: plateforme numérique DHIS2, solution numérique de production et de gestion des données
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Intérieur, du Développement Communautaire et de la Sécurité Publique, direction des statistiques; supported by UNICEF, UNFPA and UNDP
systems.tiers: Under development at 12 March 2026; to collect data from the communes up to central level, public security among its domains; pilot planned for May 2026 in some regions before national extension, with over a thousand users to be trained

note: The platform is described as collecting statistical data for the ministry's planning, public security among several domains, which is the statistics class; the document does not say that police stations or posts record reports or cases in it.
